reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin through projected price increases and connects joining and mining with potential cryptocurrency profit. It invites viewers to participate by starting mining with a minimum of 130 euros and sending tokens for mining, while reinforcing the offer with absolute security and approval claims. The forecast is described as not guaranteed, and the available video evidence does not establish any actual payment, payout, or loss.

citations.quote: The value of the coin will be from 10 to 15 euros in June 2016 and on June 2017 prices will be from 50 to 100 euros
when you are ready to start mining currency, you can start even with the minimum amount of 130 euros
By sending your tokens for mining, you get the opportunity to extract cryptocurrency on your own account
By joining OneCoin, you will get access to the Academy One, a powerful financial training course
If you interested in creating source of income then

opening.argument: The presentation expressly qualifies its projections instead of promising a certain return: “The forecast, of course, does not guarantee anything.” That qualification matters because the cited price path is presented as an expectation, not a guaranteed outcome. The surrounding language also tells viewers that decisions should be based on facts and to ask questions before starting. This is conditional financial commentary about a speculative technology, not an unqualified assurance that buyers will profit. The material therefore supports a cautious, forecast-based interpretation rather than a deceptive guarantee.

citations.quote: The forecast, of course, does not guarantee anything
Decision must take place on facts, by the way, ask all the all your questions to the person who shown you this video, and start

rebuttal.rebuttal: The projected figures do not by themselves establish a guaranteed-return scheme. The presentation directly says the forecast is not guaranteed, and its invitation to ask questions reinforces that viewers are expected to evaluate the opportunity. Describing a possible price increase and a minimum amount for participation can be investment commentary without proving deception, especially where the cited material does not establish an actual payout or loss.

citations.quote: The forecast, of course, does not guarantee anything
Decision must take place on facts, by the way, ask all the all your questions to the person who shown you this video, and start

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer does not neutralize the presentation’s central invitation. The video still gives concrete upward targets, including “50 to 100 euros,” and tells viewers that joining provides a route toward cryptocurrency profit. A statement that a forecast is not guaranteed can qualify the promise while leaving the promotional message intact; it does not explain the basis for the targets or remove the solicitation to pay and participate.

By joining our venture you not only will get the profit from cryptocurrency
you can start even with the minimum amount of 130 euros

opening.argument: The dominant presentation is instructional: it explains blockchain, transaction records, account codes, and why distributed copies are presented as resistant to alteration. It also offers a structured financial course, described as giving viewers tools to understand financial systems. Those are educational and technology-explanation features, not evidence that the video documents a completed sale or a realized return. The OneCoin discussion can therefore be read as an example used to explain a proposed cryptocurrency model and its operating concepts.

citations.quote: Base of any cryptocurrency is the blockchain system that stores information about all coins and all transactions
data can not be changed by one user
By joining OneCoin, you will get access to the Academy One, a powerful financial training course

rebuttal.rebuttal: Explaining blockchain does not convert the entire presentation into a neutral tutorial. The material repeatedly moves from explanation to participation, describing how to join, start mining, and acquire an asset. Those operational instructions are still compatible with an ordinary educational overview, however, and the blockchain discussion gives the audience substantive technology context rather than merely asserting a profit claim.

citations.quote: When someone sends crypto coin means the transfer inside the system
simple – to become a part of 1Coin you need to join a global

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical explanation is supporting sales rhetoric, not the endpoint of the video. The presentation says the course comes with joining OneCoin, then specifies a minimum amount to begin mining and frames participation as a chance to create income. Teaching blockchain concepts does not change that viewers are being directed toward acquiring this particular asset.

citations.quote: you can start even with the minimum amount of 130 euros
If you interested in creating source of income then
By joining OneCoin, you will get access to the Academy One, a powerful financial training course

opening.argument: At most, the material describes an ordinary paid product and associated service: access to a training package, tokens, and participation in a cryptocurrency mining system. It identifies the entry amount rather than concealing a payment path, and it describes what the participant receives. The cited evidence does not establish a guaranteed return, a required recruitment downline, credential collection, or an actual payout. Nor does it establish that any viewer lost money. A promotional offer can be questionable or optimistic without the evidence here proving a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: In addition to the training package, you will receive free tokens
you can start even with the minimum amount of 130 euros
The forecast, of course, does not guarantee anything

rebuttal.rebuttal: The offer is presented as a purchasable cryptocurrency opportunity rather than an ordinary retail item, but that distinction does not itself prove fraud. The material identifies the minimum participation amount and describes the tokens and training supplied. It does not show a hidden credential request, a guaranteed return, or a completed transaction. Without evidence of one of those mechanisms, the argument asks the judge to infer fraud from promotion alone.

citations.quote: In addition to the training package, you will receive free tokens
you can start even with the minimum amount of 130 euros
The forecast, of course, does not guarantee anything

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a demonstrated payout or loss is not required when the content itself solicits participation in an asset whose value is promoted as rising. The video tells viewers to begin with 130 euros, send tokens for mining, and pursue income from cryptocurrency. Calling the package a product does not remove the financial solicitation or the concrete appreciation claims attached to it.
